text:
A research protocol isn't a personal prescription. There's a difference.

Published studies tell you what was tested. Your doctor tells you what's right for you.

PepeTrack helps you understand the first and organize your notes for the second.
https://x.ai/bot/nooY_fiizqHxS9TB4z74g

For research & educational purposes only. Not medical advice.
